boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission ways to spend time together on campus and around Lexington.

cards.title: Visit Morlan Gallery
cards.subtitle: Mitchell Fine Arts Center, Transylvania University
cards.notes: Check the exhibition listing, then walk through the gallery together and spend a few minutes comparing one work that catches each person’s attention.
cards.short_summary: A campus contemporary-art stop with free public programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania’s Morlan Gallery says its artist lectures, exhibition receptions, and events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free public programming; confirm the current exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Browse Central Library
cards.subtitle: 140 East Main Street, downtown Lexington
cards.notes: Meet by the Foucault pendulum, browse the Kentucky Room or gallery, and use the library as an indoor conversation-and-reading stop.
cards.short_summary: A downtown library with public spaces, exhibits, and local-history resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington Public Library describes itself as providing free and open access to information and lists Central Library’s public facilities.
cards.access_notes: Public library location; borrowing materials may require a library card.

cards.title: See the UK Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Singletary Center for the Arts, University of Kentucky
cards.notes: Choose one gallery at a time, then trade observations about a work without rushing through the full museum or buying anything.
cards.short_summary: Free university-museum admission for a focused art break.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Kentucky Parents & Families states that admission to the University of Kentucky Art Museum is always free.
cards.source_title: Spring Family Reunion Events | University of Kentucky
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; check museum hours and exhibition availability before going.

cards.title: Walk the 21c galleries
cards.subtitle: 167 West Main Street, downtown Lexington
cards.notes: Enter for the contemporary installations, take a slow gallery loop, and use the artwork as a prompt for a relaxed group discussion.
cards.short_summary: Contemporary art galleries open to the public every day.
cards.evidence_claim: 21c’s Lexington exhibition brochure says its contemporary art museum is free and open to the public every day of the year.
cards.access_notes: Museum galleries are free and public; restaurant purchases are optional and not part of this activity.

cards.title: Look into Artists' Attic
cards.subtitle: The Square, 401 West Main Street
cards.notes: Visit during listed daytime hours, view the featured exhibition, and respectfully look into working studios when artists are present.
cards.short_summary: A downtown gallery and working-studio visit with free public access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Square states that Artists’ Attic is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free public entry; the source lists Monday–Saturday daytime hours.

cards.entity_name: The Arboretum, State Botanical Garden of Kentucky
cards.title: Walk Across Kentucky
cards.subtitle: 500 Alumni Drive, University of Kentucky
cards.notes: Follow part of the Walk Across Kentucky trail, pausing at signs and plantings; bring water and stay on marked paths from dawn to dusk.
cards.short_summary: A 100-acre public garden with a free, self-guided native-plant walk.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Kentucky states that The Arboretum is open 365 days a year from dawn to dusk and that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Plant Study Sites | University of Kentucky
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; the grounds close to the public on UK football home-game days.

cards.title: See an Institute 193 exhibition
cards.subtitle: 215 North Limestone Street, downtown Lexington
cards.notes: Check the exhibition page before heading over, then give yourselves time to engage with the work without treating the gallery shop as required.
cards.short_summary: A North Limestone exhibition space listed as free for self-guided visits.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitLEX lists Institute 193 as free and identifies self-guided tours at its North Limestone gallery.
cards.access_notes: Listed as free; verify current exhibition hours directly with Institute 193.

cards.title: Take a LexArts HOP gallery stroll
cards.subtitle: Participating Lexington galleries; includes Morlan Gallery
cards.notes: Use the official guide to select a few participating venues, walk the route with friends, and focus on the exhibitions rather than purchases.
cards.short_summary: A recurring citywide gallery evening with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: LexArts HOP states that it takes place every other month and that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Free admission; confirm participating venues and current dates on the official HOP guide.

cards.title: Walk McConnell Springs trails
cards.subtitle: 416 Rebmann Lane, Lexington
cards.notes: Follow the nearly two miles of trails with a friend, stopping at the spring features and historic markers while keeping to designated routes.
cards.short_summary: A city natural-area park with trails and karst springs.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington Parks & Recreation describes McConnell Springs as a natural-area park with nearly two miles of trails for all to enjoy.
cards.source_title: McConnell Springs Park | City of Lexington
cards.access_notes: City park access requires no admission or purchase; follow posted park guidelines.

cards.title: Take a respectful cemetery walk
cards.subtitle: 833 West Main Street, Lexington
cards.notes: Use the cemetery roads for a quiet walk, read historic markers from a distance, and observe visitor rules around graves, services, and lakes.
cards.short_summary: A historic public cemetery whose visitor rules permit walking.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lexington Cemetery identifies itself as a public cemetery, invites the public to enjoy its garden-and-park setting, and limits sports activity to walking.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are open daily; no admission or purchase is required. Visitors under 18 must be accompanied by a responsible adult.
